Common questions Four home loan questions that come up early These are the questions buyers usually want answered before the property shortlist becomes urgent. The full FAQ expands into suburb and service-specific detail. How much deposit do I need to buy in Parramatta? ⌄ Deposit needs change by lender, property type and whether LMI or a guarantee is in the structure. Many buyers start by checking what the monthly repayment still looks like after rates, strata and moving costs are included. What is the NSW First Home Owner Grant? ⌄ The NSW First Home Owner Grant currently applies to eligible new homes within the state caps. It is most useful when it is tested alongside duty settings, deposit size and the lender's own policy rather than treated as a shortcut on its own. Do first home buyers pay stamp duty in NSW? ⌄ Some first-home buyers qualify for a full exemption or a concessional rate depending on the purchase price and eligibility. It is worth checking the exact thresholds before the suburb shortlist becomes too narrow. Can a self-employed borrower still get a home loan? ⌄ Yes, although lender choice and document quality matter more. Tax returns, BAS history, entity structure and the timing of the purchase can all change which lenders are realistic.
